free_tier.stated: 1 TB minimum monthly charge; RCS 25 TB+ blocks

egress.terms: Verbatim: 'Egress & API fees | $0'. No egress charge, no API request charge, on both Pay-as-You-Go and Reserved Capacity.

limits_note: 90-day minimum storage duration (pay-as-you-go). Minimum monthly charge tied to 1 TB active storage. Free trial is only 100 GB/30 days on a company email domain, 10 GB/14 days on Gmail — not a route to free capacity.
reliability_note: The textbook 'no egress maths' provider; the catch is entirely price per TB and the 90-day minimum, not hidden fees. At 20 TB archive it is 4× Hetzner BX41.
